title: Cut off border colors on color selection screens
description: The border colors are not fully displayed on the 'Select Color' screen accessible from Theme, Group, and Event details.
steps: Select an existing group to edit.
Tap on the 'Color' option to open the color selection screen.
Observe the border colors on the color selection screen.
actual: On the 'Select Color' screen accessed via Group details, the border colors have their edges cut off.
expected: The border colors on the 'Select Color' screen should be fully visible and not cut off.
